input.scenario_description: You manage a pension fund liability-driven investment portfolio. The mandate requires minimizing variance while keeping tracking error below 2% versus the benchmark. The portfolio must be long-only, factor-neutral to market, SMB, and HML factors, and no single position may exceed 3%. Formulate the correct optimizer call.

metadata.tests_skill: translating mandate language into optimizer parameters

prompt.task_description: You are a portfolio manager with the mandate described below. Translate the mandate requirements into the correct parameters for the optimize_portfolio tool. The scenario: You manage a pension fund liability-driven investment portfolio. The mandate requires minimizing variance while keeping tracking error below 2% versus the benchmark. The portfolio must be long-only, factor-neutral to market, SMB, and HML factors, and no single position may exceed 3%. Formulate the correct optimizer call. Formulate the correct optimizer call with appropriate constraints, objective, and inputs as of 2025-10-31.
prompt.output_instructions: Respond with a JSON object containing: optimizer_call (object with constraints, objective, and any other required parameters matching the optimize_portfolio API).
